applies_why: The judge does not ground UNDERDETERMINED on a single verse's failure to state a link or contrary; it grounds it on the defender's recorded dropping of the curse limb, leaving no live link to contradict.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
why: K-S2 governs single-verse non-statement, but this judge's UNDERDETERMINED reason rests on the dropped live link, not on such non-statement.
